tables.cash_transactions:
CREATE TABLE `cash_transactions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `transaction_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'other_income or expense; invoice receipts belong in payments',
  `amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  `occurred_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `recorded_by` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `recorded_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `deleted_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_cash_transactions_recorder` (`recorded_by`),
  KEY `ix_cash_transactions_date` (`occurred_at`,`transaction_type`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cash_transactions_recorder` FOREIGN KEY (`recorded_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,

  CONSTRAINT `ck_cash_transactions_description` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`description`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_cash_transactions_type` CHECK ((`transaction_type` in (_utf8mb4'other_income',_utf8mb4'expense')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Other income and expenses, excluding invoice payment receipts'
tables.invoice_access_grants:
CREATE TABLE `invoice_access_grants` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `invoice_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `occupancy_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Scope key prevents cross-group representative grants',
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tenant account receiving access',
  `representative_assignment_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Representative assignment used to justify access',
  `granted_by` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `granted_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `revoked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `grant_reason` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `active_invoice_id` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`revoked_at` is null) then `invoice_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoice_access_active` (`active_invoice_id`),
  KEY `fk_invoice_access_invoice` (`invoice_id`,`occupancy_id`),
  KEY `fk_invoice_access_representative` (`representative_assignment_id`,`occupancy_id`),
  KEY `fk_invoice_access_granter` (`granted_by`),
  KEY `ix_invoice_access_user` (`user_id`,`revoked_at`,`invoice_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoice_access_granter` FOREIGN KEY (`granted_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoice_access_invoice` FOREIGN KEY (`invoice_id`, `occupancy_id`) REFERENCES `invoices` (`id`, `occupancy_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoice_access_representative` FOREIGN KEY (`representative_assignment_id`, `occupancy_id`) REFERENCES `representative_assignments` (`id`, `occupancy_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoice_access_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoice_access_dates` CHECK (((`revoked_at` is null) or (`revoked_at` >= `granted_at`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoice_access_reason` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`grant_reason`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Explicit per-invoice tenant permissions with revocation history'

tables.invoice_items:
CREATE TABLE `invoice_items` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `invoice_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `occupancy_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Scope key for composite foreign keys',
  `item_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'rent or service',
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Description snapshot at issue time',
  `unit` varchar(30) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Unit snapshot at issue time',
  `quantity` decimal(15,3) NOT NULL,
  `unit_price` decimal(18,4) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Rent: common monthly charge once per group-month, zero for already billed transfers; service: price snapshot',
  `line_total` decimal(18,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (round((`quantity` * `unit_price`),2)) STORED,
  `occupancy_service_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `meter_reading_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `charge_period_start` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Service source interval; mandatory for service items',
  `charge_period_end` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `rent_invoice_id` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`item_type` = _utf8mb4'rent') then `invoice_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoice_items_rent` (`rent_invoice_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoice_items_reading` (`meter_reading_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoice_items_source` (`occupancy_service_id`,`charge_period_start`,`charge_period_end`),
  KEY `fk_invoice_items_invoice` (`invoice_id`,`occupancy_id`),
  KEY `fk_invoice_items_service` (`occupancy_service_id`,`occupancy_id`),
  KEY `fk_invoice_items_reading` (`meter_reading_id`,`occupancy_service_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoice_items_invoice` FOREIGN KEY (`invoice_id`, `occupancy_id`) REFERENCES `invoices` (`id`, `occupancy_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoice_items_reading` FOREIGN KEY (`meter_reading_id`, `occupancy_service_id`) REFERENCES `meter_readings` (`id`, `occupancy_service_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoice_items_service` FOREIGN KEY (`occupancy_service_id`, `occupancy_id`) REFERENCES `occupancy_services` (`id`, `occupancy_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoice_items_amounts` CHECK (((`quantity` >= 0) and (`unit_price` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoice_items_description` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`description`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoice_items_shape` CHECK ((((`item_type` = _utf8mb4'rent') and (`quantity` = 1) and (`occupancy_service_id` is null) and (`meter_reading_id` is null) and (`charge_period_start` is null) and (`charge_period_end` is null)) or ((`item_type` = _utf8mb4'service') and (`occupancy_service_id` is not null) and (`charge_period_start` is not null) and (`charge_period_end` is not null) and (`charge_period_end` > `charge_period_start`)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoice_items_type` CHECK ((`item_type` in (_utf8mb4'rent',_utf8mb4'service'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoice_items_unit` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`unit`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Immutable invoice lines after publication; rent always quantity one'
tables.invoices:

  `due_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `cancelled_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoices_number` (`invoice_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoices_month` (`occupancy_id`,`billing_month`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoices_scope` (`id`,`occupancy_id`),
  KEY `fk_invoices_representative` (`representative_assignment_id`,`occupancy_id`),
  KEY `fk_invoices_issuer` (`issued_by`),

  KEY `invoices_due_date_index` (`due_date`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoices_issuer` FOREIGN KEY (`issued_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoices_occupancy` FOREIGN KEY (`occupancy_id`) REFERENCES `occupancies` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_invoices_representative` FOREIGN KEY (`representative_assignment_id`, `occupancy_id`) REFERENCES `representative_assignments` (`id`, `occupancy_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoices_month` CHECK ((dayofmonth(`billing_month`) = 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_invoices_number` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`invoice_number`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Issued invoices only; preview is not persisted'

tables.meter_readings:

  `recorded_by` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

tables.occupancies:
CREATE TABLE `occupancies` (

  `rental_group_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `previous_occupancy_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,

  `started_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `ended_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'NULL means the occupancy has not ended',

  `active_room_id` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`ended_at` is null) then `room_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `active_rental_group_id` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`ended_at` is null) then `rental_group_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_occupancies_group_scope` (`id`,`rental_group_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_occupancies_active_room` (`active_room_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_occupancies_previous` (`previous_occupancy_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_occupancies_active_group` (`active_rental_group_id`),
  KEY `ix_occupancies_room_dates` (`room_id`,`started_at`,`ended_at`),
  KEY `ix_occupancies_group_dates` (`rental_group_id`,`started_at`,`ended_at`),
  KEY `fk_occupancies_previous_group` (`previous_occupancy_id`,`rental_group_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_occupancies_group` FOREIGN KEY (`rental_group_id`) REFERENCES `rental_groups` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_occupancies_previous_group` FOREIGN KEY (`previous_occupancy_id`, `rental_group_id`) REFERENCES `occupancies` (`id`, `rental_group_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_occupancies_room` FOREIGN KEY (`room_id`) REFERENCES `rooms` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_occupancies_dates` CHECK (((`ended_at` is null) or (`ended_at` > `started_at`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_occupancies_rent` CHECK ((`monthly_rent` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Group residence episode; not a rental contract'
tables.occupancy_services:

tables.payment_corrections:

tables.payments:

tables.rental_properties:

tables.representative_assignments:

tables.rooms:
CREATE TABLE `rooms` (

tables.services:

tables.tenant_stays:

tables.tenants:

tables.users:

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Owner and tenant representative accounts'

coalesce(`p`.`paid_amount`,0.00)) AS `outstanding_amount`,coalesce(`li`.`total_amount`,0.00) AS `original_amount`,coalesce(`a`.`amount`,0.00) AS `adjustment_amount`,(case when (`i`.`cancelled_at` is not null) then 'cancelled' when ((coalesce(`li`.`line_count`,0) = 0) or ((case when (`i`.`cancelled_at` is not null) then 0.00 else (coalesce(`li`.`total_amount`,0.00) + coalesce(`a`.`amount`,0.00)) end) < 0)) then 'inconsistent' when (coalesce(`p`.`paid_amount`,0.00) > (case when (`i`.`cancelled_at` is not null) then 0.00 else (coalesce(`li`.`total_amount`,0.00) + coalesce(`a`.`amount`,0.00)) end)) then 'inconsistent' when (coalesce(`p`.`paid_amount`,0.00) = (case when (`i`.`cancelled_at` is not null) then 0.00 else (coalesce(`li`.`total_amount`,0.00) + coalesce(`a`.`amount`,0.00)) end)) then 'paid' when (coalesce(`p`.`paid_amount`,0.00) = 0) then 'unpaid' else 'partially_paid' end) AS `payment_status` from (((`invoices` `i` left join (select `invoice_items`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,count(0) AS `line_count`,sum(`invoice_items`.`line_total`) AS `total_amount` from `invoice_items` group by `invoice_items`.`invoice_id`) `li` on((`li`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`id`))) left join (select `payments`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,sum(`payments`.`amount`) AS `paid_amount` from `payments` where exists(select 1 from `payment_corrections` `pc` where (`pc`.`payment_id` = `payments`.`id`)) is false group by `payments`.`invoice_id`) `p` on((`p`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`id`))) left join (select `invoice_changes`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,sum(`invoice_changes`.`amount`) AS `amount` from `invoice_changes` where (`invoice_changes`.`action` = 'adjustment') group by `invoice_changes`.`invoice_id`) `a` on((`a`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`id`)))
